title: Flight Simulator 2020 - POI's - USA - Cape Hatteras Light
description:
In this video we will fly over Cape Hatteras Light. Cape Hatteras Light is a lighthouse located on Hatteras Island in the Outer Banks in the town of Buxton, North Carolina and is part of the Cape Hatteras National Seashore.[2][3][4] The lighthouse’s semi-unique pattern makes it easy to recognize and famous. It is often ranked high on lists of most beautiful, and famous lighthouses in the US.
